retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast magenta and black duotone portrait featuring vertical, segmented display typography and a realistic plastic shrink-wrap overlay.

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast portrait of a punk-styled figure rendered in a vibrant magenta and deep black duotone, framed by a vertical black sidebar containing segmented display type, all finished with a glossy, wrinkled plastic wrap texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Magenta highlights against deep black shadows
Vertical text alignment balancing the central portrait
Tactile plastic texture unifying the foreground and background
Segmented horizontal lines cutting through bold letterforms
coreInvariants: Strict magenta and black duotone color palette
Visible plastic shrink-wrap wrinkles and highlights
Vertical orientation of the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot of a figure, slightly angled, occupying 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face of the subject and the bold vertical text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes to the vertical text on the right, then following the plastic wrinkles across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the background and the solid black vertical bar on the right.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (#000000) for shadows and the sidebar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White specular highlights from the plastic wrap texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the magenta with crushed blacks for a high-impact, graphic feel.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stacking of characters rotated 90 degrees clockwise
Horizontal rhythmic slicing/segmentation across all glyphs
Uniform stroke width with rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs are divided into 4-5 horizontal segments by thin black gaps

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a black vertical bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face used for all text elements to maintain graphic intensity.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed skeleton for modification.
To achieve the specific horizontal slicing effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a punk figure in a magenta and black duotone, including a solid black vertical bar on the right side. Apply a heavy plastic wrap texture with white specular highlights over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed, uppercase magenta text vertically inside the black bar. Apply horizontal slicing gaps to the text to match the segmented style.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly magenta and black?
Is the text oriented vertically and segmented?
Is the plastic wrap texture visible across the entire composition?

adjustableVariables: Density of the plastic wrap wrinkles
Number of horizontal segments in the typography
postGenerationChecks: Check that the magenta does not bleed into other hues.
Ensure the plastic wrap highlights look like physical reflections.
Verify the text is legible despite the segmentation.
Confirm the vertical bar is perfectly aligned to the right edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast duotone portrait + vertical segmented display type + plastic wrap overlay.
